resources.string: Verify your Swiss ID in under a minute
Scan both sides of your card. If it has a chip, tap it to your phone. That\'s it.
Could not prepare the on-device checks
Checks run on this phone. Photos are encrypted for the verification team only.

Every signal, score and reason is shown live, including during capture. Switch to Production to see exactly what an applicant sees: guidance only, no indicators. The same signals are collected silently either way. Release builds have no verbose view.
Production: no indicators, signals collected silently
Camera access is needed to scan your document
Place the side with your photo inside the frame
Turn your card over. Keep the three lines of code in view
Now the back: keep the three lines of code sharp and inside the frame
Place your card inside the frame
Center the card in the frame
Hold steady, the image is blurry
Keep your fingers off the card
Tilt the card slightly to avoid glare
Make sure the photo is clearly visible
Keep the three lines of code sharp and in view
You chose %1$s, but the card you scanned reads as a %2$s. Continue with the correct document type?
Hold your card flat against the back of your phone, near the camera, and keep still for a few seconds.
NFC is off. Turn it on to read the chip.
This phone cannot read chips, so we\'ll continue without it.
That didn\'t work. Hold the card still against the phone and try again.
We couldn\'t open the chip. Rescan the back of your card so we can read the code.
Your card has a chip, so we need to read it. Hold your card flat against the back of your phone, near the camera, and keep still for a few seconds.
Your card has a chip, but this phone cannot read chips. We\'ll continue with the photos only, which may take longer to confirm.
I can\'t get the chip to read
Place your face in the oval
Center your face in the oval
Keep your eyes open and look at the screen
Avoid strong light on your face
Look at the camera, then do 3 quick moves
← Turn your head to the left
Turn your head to the right →
↖ Tilt your head to the left shoulder
Tilt your head to the right shoulder ↗
We need one more quick selfie check to finish verifying your identity.
Thanks. We\'re confirming your document and will let you know shortly.
Your identity check is complete. You can close this screen.
Thanks. A specialist is reviewing your submission and will follow up shortly.
We couldn\'t finish this check online. Please visit your nearest branch with your ID — you can appeal and complete verification there.
Risk points are hand-set weights for this demo, not a trained model. The same signals are written to the session payload in production, where the applicant sees none of them.
